world.name: Moppetopia
world.description: Felt sailors, a water world, and a nebula of stale cookies. Two hundred years after the Treaty of Soft Landings ended the Great Puddle War, the Puddle Navy keeps the peace from the USS Fuzzball, the Eternal Drip keeps everyone damp, and Admiral Fluffington and Captain Snoot are still not speaking.

element.name: Admiral Fluffington
element.description: Admiral of the Puddle Navy and commander of the USS Fuzzball. Pink felt, immaculately kept, with one googly eye that was Admiral Splashworth's, and with it some of Splashworth's memories. Son of Admiral Stuffington and the last of House Stuffington. He and Captain Snoot were friends at the Naval Academy until The Incident. His catchphrase: "We sail where the puddles flow." The family crest, three water drops and a felt star, hangs on the Fuzzball's bridge.
element.physicality: Pink felt, immaculately kept. One googly eye, Splashworth's left, transplanted.
element.mentality: Does his job exactly as the Puddle Navy trained him to. Wakes some nights seeing things he didn't live through, and tasting oats, which nobody in Moppetopia eats. It is getting harder to tell where duty ends and denial begins.
element.background: Son of Admiral Stuffington. Naval Academy graduate, then Admiral. Carries Splashworth's eye, and possibly his guilt.

element.name: We Sail Where the Puddles Flow
element.description: The Puddle Navy's motto, and Admiral Fluffington's catchphrase. Moppets say it at launches and at funerals, in the same voice.
element.rationale: Admiral Fluffington's catchphrase and the Puddle Navy's unofficial motto. On the surface: heroic naval tradition, brave explorers following water wherever it leads. Underneath: a coping mechanism so effective it became cultural infrastructure. You say it when you need to keep moving and cannot afford to look down. The puddles flow, you follow them, and you do not ask where they came from or what they are flowing over. Every moppet who repeats it is participating in a collective act of looking forward instead of back. The silliness is load-bearing.
element.history: Origin unclear and deliberately unexamined. Some credit Splashworth himself, which would make it devastating irony given how he actually died. Others say it predates the Navy entirely -- an old Puddleton saying from before moppets left the surface. The Treaty Council has never officially endorsed it, which is the surest sign they find it useful. By Year 200 it had migrated from naval slang to civilian greeting, school motto, and Feltropolis tourism tagline. Madame Threadbare sells embroidered versions at The Thread Market. They are her third-highest margin item.
element.status: Culturally ubiquitous. Repeated by sailors and civilians, printed on merchandise, taught to children. Comforts and deflects in equal measure. Enables the continued functioning of a society built on suppressed truth. The Crumbler reportedly heard it for the first time via intercepted Navy comms and laughed for three minutes straight.

element.name: Year Zero Anniversary
element.description: Annual commemoration of the Treaty of Soft Landings signing (Year 0). Celebrated throughout moppet space. Drizzle has a private tradition: every anniversary she sends Admiral Fluffington a drink. He never touches it. Neither of them explains it.
element.rationale: Commemorates peace and the founding of the current calendar system. Also commemorates a war crime.
element.history: Celebrated for 200 years since the Treaty.

element.name: Puddleton
element.description: Capital city of moppet civilization. A water-based metropolis built around the Eternal Drip.

element.name: Feltropolis
element.description: Orbital space station and primary manufacturing hub for felt technology: a spindle of seven levels, from The Docks at the bottom to The Spire at the top.

element.name: Moppet
element.description: The people of Moppetopia: small felt creatures with googly eyes, who eat by absorbing moisture. Puddle Moppets, Dust Moppets, Space Moppets and Feral Moppets are its kinds.

element.name: Puddle Moppet
element.description: The standard moppet subtype. Water-absorbing, traditional, mostly found in Puddleton.

element.name: Standard Moppet
element.description: The common language of moppet space, written and spoken the same in Puddleton and on Feltropolis. The Crumbler's three-word message went out in plain Standard, and The Claw still spent six weeks looking for the encryption.

element.name: Medal of Damp Valor
element.description: Puddle Navy military decoration featuring a three-splash insignia. Worn by Admiral Fluffington.

element.name: Splashworth's Compass
element.description: Old compass that belonged to Admiral Splashworth, now carried by Admiral Fluffington as a keepsake. Nobody knows whether it works. Some say it points to the truth.

element.name: USS Fuzzball
element.description: Flagship of the Puddle Navy commanded by Admiral Fluffington.

element.name: Puddle Navy
element.description: The fleet of Puddleton, which fights in puddles and in space. Its Academy still teaches Splashworth's tactics from Damp Ridge.

element.name: House Stuffington
element.description: The preeminent naval dynasty of Puddleton. Three generations of Admirals, or two, depending on what you believe. Admiral Stuffington (the patriarch) is officially deceased, a war hero who gave everything for the Puddle Navy. Admiral Fluffington (his son) carries the name with pink-felted dignity and an inherited compass. The family crest features three water drops and a felt star, which adorns the USS Fuzzball's bridge. There are no other known Stuffingtons, which makes Fluffington the last of the line, a fact he drinks about more than he'd admit.

element.name: Captain Snoot
element.description: Rogue explorer, smuggler, and the one who knows. Faded blue felt, one googly eye missing since the Snack Nebula crash; under the eyepatch there may be the Googly Eye of Truth. He left the Puddle Navy after The Incident (Year 120 YSL) with evidence of the Moistened Valley Massacre cover-up, and has kept it hidden ever since. He drinks at The Soggy Sock, trades with the Cookie Pirates, and buys information from Madame Threadbare at The Thread Market, playing both sides. In Year 203 YSL he found The Rolling Pin past the Crumblefields, a humming Bakerfolk ruin three kilometers long, and brought back a fragment that hums in time with the Eternal Drip's pump cycle.
element.physicality: Faded blue felt. One googly eye missing, behind an eyepatch that may hold the Googly Eye of Truth.
element.reputation: Disgraced ex-officer to the establishment. A folk hero to those who suspect the truth.
